canonical.definition: MICROKAPPA is the ELIMFILTERS cabin-air protection architecture for particulate and selected gaseous-contaminant control.
canonical.systems: Air Intake & Airflow Protection; operator cabin HVAC filtration.
canonical.failure_impact: Inadequate cabin-air filtration can increase operator exposure to airborne particulate contamination and can reduce HVAC air-quality performance in demanding operating environments.
canonical.related_standards: Applicable cabin-air test standards and occupational requirements must be matched to the approved application and filtration configuration; no universal certification or efficiency claim is implied by the technology name alone.
canonical.related_technologies: MACROCORE: Engine-air filtration architecture for primary and secondary engine intake protection. INTEKCORE: Air-cleaner housing and sealing architecture for the protected engine-intake boundary. These technologies protect different air pathways and must not be represented as cabin-air substitutes.
canonical.industrial_role: MICROKAPPA provides the operator-environment filtration layer of ELIMFILTERS Air Intake & Airflow Protection. Media selection is governed by the operating environment, exposure requirement, airflow demand and HVAC pressure-drop constraints.
